concept.title: Git Client Add-on
concept.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , so you can commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

conbody.note: This add-on is compatible with Oxygen XML Editor, Oxygen XML Author, Oxygen XML Developer, and Oxygen JSON Editor.
conbody.p: After you install it, the Git Client adds three dedicated views, a top-level menu, several preferences pages, and contextual Git actions in other views and editors.

ul.li: - This is where you review changes, stage them, commit, push, and pull.
- It displays the commit graph so you can inspect and compare revisions.
- This view lists your local and remote branches so you can manage them.

conbody.p: The topics that follow are arranged in the order you will usually need them: install the add-on, get oriented, connect to a server, and set up a repository, then review and commit your work, synchronize with the remote, resolve conflicts, work with branches and tags, and review history. Advanced workflows, configuration, a full interface and actions reference, and troubleshooting come at the end for reference purposes.
